content.comment_body: Connection between two [product_name] devices, both configured as Master with a program. The connection for transferring an analog value between them works during testing and the data is updated. However, loading the programs onto each [product_name] does not produce the same results. Where could my mistake be?

Dear [user_name], Please note that the forum language is English; kindly write your posts in English in the future. Upload both program files so they can be reviewed. It is difficult to provide feedback without knowing the actual programs.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces inconsistent outcomes when running identical programs on two connected [product_name] devices. Although analog value sharing works during tests, the behavior differs in actual usage, causing confusion and failing to meet expectations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that identical programs on similar devices set up for data exchange will behave consistently in both testing scenarios and live operation.
